images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: 3514 Beechway

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a 1940s brick Colonial with shuttered upper windows, a dormered wing holding a front garage, a bow window by the door, a flagstone-edged ribbon drive and walk

why.note: the garage moves from the back yard into the house front, 1940s-50s
